I was told during COVID they ran out of hospital beds !!!! Yet these hospitals are empty and these nurses had time to rehearse complicated dance moves for hours, then perform them in empty hospitals and film them! 

I confronted a nurse over this & she actually said “Yes, we did dance routines to ‘BLOW OFF STEAM’”. 

She claimed they were working 16 hour days because of all the sick Covid patients, then would rehearse complicated dance moves for hour after hour double shit to “BLOW OFF STEAM”?!?
